name: Camping Sunnawirt
beschreibung: The Sunnawirt campsite is located in the municipality of Heiterwang in the district of Reutte in Tirol. The surroundings are characterized by the Ammergauer Alpen and the lake landscape of Heiterwanger See and Plansee. The facility is a touring and permanent campsite with a quiet, close-to-nature atmosphere. In summer, the site serves as a base for hikes and bike rides in Außerfern. In winter, the ski areas of Zugspitzarena (including Berwang, Lermoos and Ehrwald) are easily accessible. The infrastructure includes modern sanitary facilities, a small shop, a guest kitchen and a bread roll service. A restaurant with regional cuisine complements the offering. Guests can expect a well-maintained pitch in an attractive valley location with direct access to the region's leisure infrastructure.
